title: Laguna Phuket Marathon 2027 Review: What the 20th Edition Was Like
seo_title: Laguna Phuket Marathon 2027 Review | Phuket, Thailand
meta_description: Laguna Phuket Marathon review: 7,000+ runners at Laguna Grove over 13-14 June 2026, sunset and sunrise races past beaches, plantations and Thalang.
dek: The Laguna Phuket Marathon held its 20th edition over 13 and 14 June 2026, with more than 7,000 runners. Here is what it was like, ahead of 2027.
verdict: The Laguna Phuket Marathon is a resort-island marathon split over two days. The 20th edition, over 13 and 14 June 2026, drew more than 7,000 competitors to Laguna Grove [1]. Saturday's sunset runs covered 2 km, 5 km and 10 km; Sunday's sunrise runs were the half marathon and full marathon, with the marathon off at 4am [1]. The routes crossed rainforest, rubber and pineapple plantations and the Thalang district before looping along Nai Yang and Layan beaches at sunrise [1]. China's Zhipeng Huang won the marathon in 2:45:35 [1]. If you want a destination marathon with scenery and a family weekend attached, it is a good choice.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: The 20th Laguna Phuket Marathon was held at Laguna Grove over Saturday 13 and Sunday 14 June 2026, with more than 7,000 competitors from many countries [1].

The weekend is split in two. The Sunset Runs, a 2 km junior run, 5 km and 10 km, were held on Saturday between 4pm and 7.30pm; the Sunrise Runs, the half marathon and full marathon, were on Sunday morning [1]. Phuket's governor flagged off the marathon at 4am and the half marathon an hour later [1].

sections.heading: The Route
paragraphs: The routes passed through tropical rainforest, rubber and pineapple plantations and the historic Thalang district, then looped along Nai Yang and Layan beaches as the sun came up over the Andaman Sea [1].
The organisers position the June date in Phuket's green season, with cooler breezes and occasional showers [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race, and a Cause
paragraphs: Chinese runners won both marathons: Zhipeng Huang in 2:45:35 and Ling Wu in 3:03:46 [1]. Thailand's Hadee Dendu and Japan's Chiaki Morikawa won the half marathons [1].
A running club programme raised B40,000 for the Children First Fund, which helps underprivileged children in Phuket [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want to combine a marathon with a Phuket holiday. The two-day format means the whole family can race, and the sunrise finish along the beaches is the highlight.
Winning times in the 2:45 range show this is not an elite race, and June brings rain and humidity. Run it for the experience.
This review is compiled from a published report on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Laguna Phuket Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: More than 7,000 competitors took part in the 20th edition over 13 and 14 June 2026 at Laguna Grove, Phuket, across the 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and full marathon.

faqs.question: What is the Laguna Phuket Marathon route like?
faqs.answer: Scenic. In 2026 the routes passed through rainforest, rubber and pineapple plantations and the Thalang district, then looped along Nai Yang and Layan beaches at sunrise. The marathon started at 4am.

faqs.question: Why is the Laguna Phuket Marathon split over two days?
faqs.answer: The shorter Sunset Runs (2 km, 5 km and 10 km) are held on Saturday afternoon and evening, and the Sunrise Runs (half marathon and marathon) early on Sunday, so families can race and the long distances start before the heat.
